validation_results.title: Validation Results
validation_results.content:
**Responsibilities by Platform:**

| Platform | Scope of Responsibility |
|---|---|
| **SuperAdmin** | Multi-tenancy, distributor/brand onboarding, licensing, deployment, audit, monitoring, support |
| **RegionalDistributor** | Regional/country distribution rights, local contracts, rollout planning, local support, settlement tracking |
| **BrandHQ** | Menu, pricing, promotions, branch policies, brand reports, catalog distribution |
| **EdgePos** | Orders, payments, tables, customers, inventory, kiosk, device integration, local recovery |

- Legacy feature categories 1-9 have all been mapped to new platform documents
- Detailed features are most concentrated in 04 (EdgePos); 01/02/03 cover the operations/deployment/policy layers
- This matrix should be updated whenever new features are added

superadmin_features.title: SuperAdmin Feature List
superadmin_features.description: A list of upper-level management features needed for the supplier to operate multiple brands and distributors in a unified manner. This covers only platform-wide control features, not store operation features.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content: Defines the features needed for the supplier to operate multiple brands and distributors in a unified manner. This covers **only platform-wide upper-level management features**, not store operation features.

tenant_org_mgmt.title: Tenant/Organization Management
tenant_org_mgmt.content:
- Create/approve/suspend RegionalDistributors
- Onboard BrandHQ entities
- Link branch hierarchies and manage organizational structures
- Transfer account ownership and operational permissions

license_deploy.title: License/Deployment Management
license_deploy.content:
- Issue licenses per brand/region
- Manage version deployment policies
- Control rollout targets and staged deployments
- Track deployment failure/retry/approval status

policy_audit.title: Policy/Audit/Security
policy_audit.content:
- Global RBAC policies
- Audit log inquiry
- Policy template distribution
- Security/access control standards management

monitoring.title: Operations Monitoring
monitoring.content:
- Monitor brand/distributor/branch status
- Failure alerts and health checks
- Remote support records
- Deployment status and sync state tracking

contract_mgmt.title: Central Contract Management
contract_mgmt.content:
- Manage `SuperAdmin/CentralApi` GraphQL contracts
- Manage REST exception endpoint usage scope
- `SharedContracts` version management

non_responsibility.title: Out of Scope
non_responsibility.content:
- **Does not own store-level source data** such as orders, payments, tables, or inventory
- Does not directly handle Edge POS local device connections
- Does not duplicate BrandHQ operational screens
- Upper-level control features from `System & Admin` are promoted to SuperAdmin
- Legacy POS operational data belongs to EdgePos

distributor_features.title: RegionalDistributor Feature List
distributor_features.description: Defines the responsibilities of the distributor tier that holds exclusive distribution rights at the country/region level. Separates the contract, rollout, and support boundaries between brand headquarters and the supplier.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content: Defines the responsibilities of the distributor tier that holds exclusive distribution rights at the country/region level. Separates the contract, rollout, and support boundaries between brand headquarters and the supplier.

territory_mgmt.title: Territory/Country Distribution Rights Management
territory_mgmt.content:
- Manage country/region exclusive rights
- Manage assigned brand list
- Manage operational scope per region
- Reflect regional policies/regulations/tax standards

brand_onboarding.title: Brand Onboarding
brand_onboarding.content:
- Support new BrandHQ registration
- Coordinate installation scope and rollout schedules
- Deliver initial deployment packages
- Connect local support channels

contract_settlement.title: Contract/Settlement
contract_settlement.content:
- Manage distributor contract status
- Track license/contract renewals
- Manage local settlement standards
- Track commissions/support costs

regional_dashboard.title: Regional Operations Dashboard
regional_dashboard.content:
- Regional installation status
- Branch activation status
- Review failure/deployment/support history
- Operational status summary by brand

non_responsibility.title: Out of Scope
non_responsibility.content:
- Does not handle actual store order/payment data
- Does not directly control EdgePos device drivers or local DBs
- Does not duplicate BrandHQ menu/pricing/employee operation screens
- Very few features existed directly in legacy HJ-POS; this is a newly defined tier in the new platform
- Upper-level responsibilities for deployment, support, audit, and settlement absorb the periphery of legacy operational features

brandhq_features.title: BrandHQ Feature List
brandhq_features.description: Defines the features needed when a single brand operates multiple branches in a unified manner. Manages the policy source and catalog source for store operations.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content: Defines the features needed when a single brand operates multiple branches in a unified manner. Manages the **policy source and catalog source** for store operations.

menu_catalog.title: Menu/Catalog Management
menu_catalog.content:

- Catalog distribution per branch

branch_ops.title: Branch Operations
branch_ops.content:
- Create/edit/suspend branches

org_employee.title: Organization/Employee Management
org_employee.content:

report_settlement.title: Reports/Settlement
report_settlement.content:

edgepos_link.title: EdgePos Integration
edgepos_link.content:
- Distribute policies/catalogs to EdgePos
- Apply on-site settings in Setup/Maintenance mode
- Manage device templates and local commissioning information

non_responsibility.title: Out of Scope
non_responsibility.content:
- **Does not own the real-time source of order/payment transactions**
- Regional exclusive distribution rights and supplier-wide deployment policies are SuperAdmin/RegionalDistributor responsibilities
- Local device control is performed within BrandPosApp internal modes
- Absorbs the brand-operation-relevant portions of `Inventory & Menu`, `Customer`, `System & Admin`
- The management flow for products/menus/pricing/promotions is BrandHQ's core responsibility

edgepos_features.title: EdgePOS Feature List
edgepos_features.description: The final reorganization of all features from the HJ-POS-TEST legacy project (MFC/C++ POS, ~550K lines) from the EdgePos responsibility perspective. Includes 22 Manager classes, 610+ methods, and 350 dialogs.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
Most legacy features are contained in this document. The SuperAdmin / RegionalDistributor / BrandHQ documents only cover their respective upper-level operational responsibilities.

**Analysis Target**: HJ-POS-TEST (MFC/C++ POS, ~550K lines)
**Analysis Method**: 5 specialized agents in parallel analysis (full survey of Manager classes, full survey of IDD_ dialogs, resource.h scan)

stats_summary.title: Overall Statistics Summary
stats_summary.content:
| Category | Count |

table_floor.title: Table & Floor
table_floor.content:
Manager: `CTableMgr` (DB/TableMgr.h, DB/TableMgr.cpp)

Key Features:
- **Table initialization/query**: InitTable, GetTableFromTableCode, GetTableFromID (P0)
- **Table status management**: ClearTableAll, TableOrderClear, ClearOrderFromID (P0)
- **Table lock/sync**: UseSysnCheck, SetUseSysn, ChangeTableFromSock (P0)
- **Table move/merge**: ChangeTable (move to empty table or merge orders, consolidate amounts/quantities) (P0)
- **Table group management**: SetGroupView, ChangeGroupAlphabetFromSock (P1)
- **Table memo**: UpdateTableMemo (P1)
- **Reservation management**: CAppointTableviewDlg (P1)
- **Takeout/delivery table codes**: Manage dedicated codes for takeout/delivery (P1)

sales_payment.title: Sales & Payment
sales_payment.content:
Manager: `COrderMgr` + `CSaleMgr` + 7 payment gateways

Key Features:
- **Order create/edit/cancel**: Menu selection, quantity, options, special requests (P0)
- **Payment processing**: Cash/card/QR/points/coupons/credit/split payment (P0)
- **Dutch pay**: Split payment by amount/number of people/items (P0)
- **Receipt printing**: Kitchen/customer/delivery slips (P0)
- **Payment gateways**: BCCard, Infoplus, ZaloPay, HJVietPay, NAPAS, BIDV, WeTax (P0)
- **Async payment**: Async result notifications for QR payments, etc. (P1)
- **Refund/cancel**: Payment cancellation/partial refund (P0)

inventory_menu.title: Inventory & Menu
inventory_menu.content:
Manager: `CItemMgr` + `CStockMgr`

Key Features:
- **Product management**: Product registration/edit/delete, categories, options (P0)
- **Inventory management**: Inbound/outbound, status inquiry, date-based history (P1)
- **Purchasing management**: Supplier-based inbound, purchase edits, purchase ledger (P1)
- **Inventory reconciliation**: Physical count/reconciliation, inventory adjustment (P1)
- **Set menus**: Set composition, PLU code management (P1)

customer.title: Customer Management
customer.content:
Manager: `CCustMgr`

Key Features:
- **Customer registration/search**: New registration, search/select, information edit (P0)
- **Customer details**: Extended information, purchase history (P1)
- **Customer stored items**: Inbound/sale/use (P2)
- **Credit management**: Customer credit deposit/management (P1)
- **Chain customers**: Chain store shared customer list (P2)

system_admin.title: System & Admin
system_admin.content:
Manager: `CConfigMgr` + `CPrinterMgr` + 5 others

Key Features:
- **System settings**: General settings, printer settings, network settings (P0)
- **Employee management**: Employee selection/call/notifications, attendance management, salary/allowances (P1)
- **Daily settlement**: Sales aggregation, closing process (P0)
- **Printer control**: Kitchen printer, customer printer, label printer (P0)
- **Backup/restore**: DB backup, restore, data initialization (P1)
- **Remote support**: Remote access, failure log collection (P2)

external_bridge.title: External Bridge
external_bridge.content:
Manager: `CFoodingMgr` + 4 delivery services + MQTT + HTTP

Key Features:
- **Delivery services**: Yogiyo, Coupang Eats, PAYCO vORDER, BM_NEW, MConnect, KakaoTalk (P0)
- **Fooding integration**: Order acceptance/status management (P0)
- **MQTT**: Real-time message send/receive (P1)
- **HTTP**: External API calls, webhook reception (P1)
- **QR payment**: VietQR, ZaloPay QR (P0)

flow_diagram.title: Screen Navigation Flow
flow_diagram.content:
```
Main Menu (M-01)
  ├── Table Screen (M-02) → Order Screen (M-03) → Payment Screen (M-04)
  ├── Delivery Management (DEL-01~04)
  ├── Customer Management (CUS-01~11)
  ├── Inventory Management (STK-01~15)
  ├── Employee Management (EMP-01~07)
  └── System Settings

Core Revenue Flow (P0):
  Table Selection → Order Entry → Payment Processing → Receipt Printing
```
